verdict.rationale: Working Copy is a developer tool (a git client with an editor), so a built-in terminal is a fair question to ask. However, the evidence never mentions a terminal or any terminal font, color or cursor settings, or how such settings would persist. The only related item is editor font selection (docs-59), which is a different feature and earns no credit for this terminal story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can customize the font, colors, and cursor appearance of my terminal and persist the settings
